Use rhoCentralFoam as the solver in system/controlDict.
Use a two-dimensional planar mesh with one cell in the z direction and set frontAndBack patches to empty.
Set the computational domain as a rectangle extending from x = 0 m to x = 3 m and from y = -1.5 m to y = 1.5 m.
Define the supersonic inlet as a slot of height 0.01 m centered on the left boundary at y = 0 m.
Treat the portions of the left boundary above and below the inlet slot as solid walls.
Treat the right boundary and the top and bottom boundaries as far-field outlets.
Use laminar flow and do not solve any turbulence transport equations.
Use noSlip for U on the solid walls and zeroGradient for p and T on the solid walls.
Apply fixed value boundary conditions at the inlet with U = (686 0 0) m/s, p = 101325 Pa, and T = 300 K.
Apply zeroGradient to U on the far-field outlet boundaries.
Apply waveTransmissive boundary conditions to p and T on the far-field outlet boundaries using the ambient reference values p = 101325 Pa and T = 300 K.
Initialize the internal field with U = (686 0 0) m/s, p = 101325 Pa, and T = 300 K.
In constant/thermophysicalProperties set thermoType to hePsiThermo with pureMixture, hConst, perfectGas, and sutherland transport.
Set the gas properties for air with molar weight 28.96 kg/kmol and Cp = 1005 J/kg/K.
Set the Sutherland transport coefficients for air with mu = 1.846e-05 kg/m/s and Pr = 0.72.
Set the end time to 0.01 s and choose deltaT so the maximum Courant number remains below 0.5.
Generate the mesh with blockMesh so that the inlet slot is resolved by at least 10 cells across its height and the mesh is graded toward the inlet and the jet shear layer.
